extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and prospective applicants seeking National Institute on Aging (NIA) grant funding (trainees through senior investigators)
extracted.subtask_description: Overview and entry points for applying to NIA for research funding in aging and Alzheimer's disease; points applicants to policies, review changes, funding opportunities, contact points, and program-specific guidance. Serves as a portal for producing and complying with NIA grant submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simplified Review Process
rubrics_metrics.description: For due dates on or after Jan. 25, 2025 changes are coming to how most research grant applications will be reviewed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learn about the new simplified review framework (impacts how applications are evaluated starting Jan 25, 2025).

rubrics_metrics.name: Find Alzheimer's and related dementias funding opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Find Alzheimer's and related dementias funding opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Portal to funding announcements specific to Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (use to identify targeted FOAs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Find NIA Funding Opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Discover funding announcements in aging research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Browse NIA funding announcements and sign up to receive funding opportunities delivered to your inbox.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extramural Divisions & Contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Connect with NIA extramural staff on scientific and funding matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use listed contacts to ask scientific and programmatic questions relevant to application preparation and submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Sharing Resources for Researchers
rubrics_metrics.description: Obtain information on data sharing policies, considerations, and guidance available to support researchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult these resources to ensure compliance with NIA and federal data sharing expectations and to plan data management/sharing in applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding Policies & Paylines
rubrics_metrics.description: Read policies relevant to NIA applicants and grantees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes policy statements and payline information applicants should incorporate into submission planning and expectations for funding decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training & Career Development
rubrics_metrics.description: Find training and career development opportunities in aging research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information on mechanisms and programs (e.g., fellowships, career development awards) targeted to different career stages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Small Business Programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn about how we fund innovation to advance healthy aging.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on NIA funding mechanisms for small businesses, including program goals and how to identify appropriate solicitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIA Guidance on Clinical Trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn about NIA's clinical trial guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this guidance to design, document, and submit clinical trials consistent with NIA expectations and requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Grant Mechanisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Review the types of NIA research grant mechanisms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Overviews of available grant mechanisms and which are appropriate for different project types and career stages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research and Funding FAQs
rubrics_metrics.description: Read commonly asked questions about research and funding at NIA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frequently asked questions answering common procedural, eligibility, and policy issues relevant to applicants and awardees.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIA Interim Funding Line Policy for FY 2024
rubrics_metrics.description: Find information on interim pay lines for NIA- and CSR-reviewed applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details on interim funding line policy for FY2024 that affect funding decisions for reviewed applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stay Connected / Inside NIA Blog and Email Alerts
rubrics_metrics.description: Get weekly updates on NIA funding policies and research priorities with the Inside NIA Blog; sign up to receive funding opportunities delivered to your inbox and monthly email alerts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscribe to blog and email alerts to receive timely updates on policy, priorities, and new funding opportunities relevant to applicants.
